name: intro
arrangement: Sparse, warm fingerpicked upright piano introducing the tonic Bm motif with subtle room reverb. A gentle octave acoustic guitar join on beat 3 of bar 2.

name: verse_1
arrangement: Warm upright piano continues. Subtle, damp rimshot pattern enters on beat 4 alongside a round, warm electric bass playing rooted quarter notes with melodic stepwise fills.

name: pre_1
arrangement: Rhythm swells with soft brushed snare press-rolls. Bass lines become more active, moving up to G and A. High octave piano chords swell slightly with ambient delay.

name: chorus_1
arrangement: Open strummed acoustic guitar enters on both channels. Full live snare on beats 2 and 4 with crisp hi-hat open-close pedal work. Clean electric guitar plays the signature two-bar melodic hook.

name: turnaround
arrangement: Drums drop to a single Kick-rim pattern. Piano repeats the opening motif twice while electric guitar lets its last note decay into spring reverb.

name: verse_2
arrangement: Drums maintain a subtle 4-on-the-floor kick with rim clicks. Bass locks tightly to the kick drum while executing subtle slide fills into the root tones.

name: pre_2
arrangement: Building dynamic energy. Snare switches from rim to light center hits. Crescendo on the crash cymbal leading straight into the chorus explosion.

name: chorus_2
arrangement: Full band arrangement with strummed acoustic guitars, driving bassline, active live snare, and prominent electric guitar hook doubling the vocal counter-melody.

name: bridge
arrangement: Strips back suddenly to dynamic minimalist texture. Lush harmonic color provided by Gmaj7 and F#7alt chords on organ/rhodes while bass plays solitary low notes.

name: final_chorus
arrangement: Maximum emotional energy without altering the indie-pop aesthetic. Added tambourine layer, wider acoustic panning, and expressive drum fills around the hook guitar.

name: outro
arrangement: Instruments peel away one by one. Acoustic guitar strums slow down, leaving only the piano playing the unresolved Bm chord as room noise fades.
